cv.name: Rachel Leung
cv.headline: Executive Assistant | Bilingual EN/FR | Studios, academia and law
cv.summary: Bilingual executive assistant with seven years in a law firm, a university department, events and now a game studio. Organised, calm under deadlines and used to switching between English and French all day.

experience.title: Executive Assistant to the President
bullets: Manage the President's calendar, travel to conferences and investor meetings
Prepare board materials and track action items for the leadership team
Coordinate visas and onboarding logistics for international hires
Organised the studio's 10-year anniversary event for 250 guests

experience.title: Event & Office Coordinator (contract)
bullets: Coordinated client events and supplier contracts during the busy season

experience.title: Administrative Coordinator, Department of Medicine
bullets: Handled faculty recruitment files and committee scheduling
Processed research expense claims in the university financial system

experience.title: Legal Assistant
bullets: Prepared court filings and managed deadlines for two litigation partners
